n: 5.0 Cu. Ft. Mega Capacity Smart Front Load Washer With Ai Dd® 2.0 Built-in Intelligence & Turbowash® 360°
desc: Get more out of your washing machine with the 5.0 cu. ft. Mega Capacity Smart Washer from LG. This front-load washing machine features cutting-edge technology and features to save time, energy, and guesswork with every load.
hl: Built-in sensors use AI technology to detect fabric texture, soil level, and load size, then automatically select the right wash motions, temperatures and more for advanced fabric care.
Clean Up To 31 Loads With 1 Easy Fill¹

No more digging out detergent and fabric softener every time you do laundry— with ezDispense® Automatic Dispenser, just fill the reservoirs once and you’re set for up to 18 to 31 wash cycles¹ with versatility of using detergent and softener
With Smart Pairing, the washer can even tell the dryer to select a compatible drying cycle², making it the ultimate laundry hack.
Power Clean Big Loads in Under 30 Minutes³
5 powerful jets spray clothes from multiple angles for a complete clean in under 30 minutes³.
The intuitive digital dial control gives you more information with each turn.
The modern flat front design, black steel finish and tinted, tempered glass doors bring a premium point of view to your laundry space.
spec: 27" x 13 5/8" x 28" (43 7/8" D with door open)
